title: Rob Hamilton: The AI “Black Hole” is Pulling Liquidity Away from Bitcoin
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Rob Hamilton: The AI “Black Hole” is Pulling Liquidity Away from Bitcoin AnchorWatch CEO Rob Hamilton is bullish on Bitcoin in the long run, even as he watches liquidity get pulled toward the Anthropic IPO and the AI trade, which he compares to a black hole. This post Rob Hamilton: The AI “Black Hole” is Pulling Liquidity Away from Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
